# Our song

The owner explicitly identified **The One I Choose** by **Devin Velez** as the couple's memorable song. This personal association comes from the owner; the book does not invent when or why they first heard it.

The title and artist are independently confirmed by the [official Apple Music release](https://music.apple.com/us/album/the-one-i-choose-single/6791815005), checked on 27 October 2026. That release is the listening destination used by the website. No guessed Spotify/YouTube identifier, downloaded recording, lyrics or cover art is added.

The published `memorableSong` record is separate from the four favorite-artist records. The printed slip leads with “Our song”, Devin Velez and The One I Choose. Its opened reader provides the official listening link, then retains Olivia Rodrigo, Taylor Swift, Olivia Dean and Sienna Spiro.

Owner settings can edit the title, artist and HTTPS listening URL, and retain them in JSON export/import and browser-local saving. Existing saved data without this field receives the confirmed shared default while its earlier songs, artist notes and personal writing remain. An intentionally blank title falls back to the previous artist-song selection.

The official recording opens through the listening link. Existing instrumental ambient controls and the candle-controlled Happy Birthday melody retain their behavior; this update does not present the ambient music-box synthesis as Devin Velez's recording.
